provenance: DIC-1232 backfill from official X result announcements (fxtwitter-resolved status payloads, 2026-08-29). Each event aggregates its published A/B/C/D blocks into ONE event so the same tournament is not double-counted. Event identity, region, date and official source URL are verifiable from the tweet text + timestamps. Official deck codes ARE published (in the announcement images) but were not extracted in this run; per DIC-1232 req-2 the events are kept with an explicit unverified deck list rather than guessed or dropped. A later --live Deck Log pass (or a human verifying the images) fills verified cards.
